title: PHANTOM TOOLS Universal Utility v3 By PhantomScripts
features:
Phantom Tools is a fully custom, premium universal player script built for all executors including Opiumware, Synapse X, KRNL, Delta, Fluxus, Arceus X, Trigon and Codex.

No Rayfield. No libraries. Fully hand-built custom UI with smooth animations, toggle pills, live sliders, and a notification system. Looks better than any free script out there.
